findings.failure_path: A delivery request mentioning brainstorm or plan-writing as an auxiliary step now qualifies for treating that skill as the primary action. Previously, this exception required the user to explicitly select it as the primary or only action. The broader exception permits delivery work to leave this router before its initial classification.
findings.smallest_fix: Restore the explicit primary-or-only-action qualifier; otherwise invoke the named process skill within the applicable delivery stage.

findings.failure_path: Single-repository product/spec normalization that edits no verifier or external-consumer contract matches neither G4 trigger. It can therefore proceed as ordinary documentation without the artifact classification previously required explicitly for product/spec normalization and standards-to-health-gate work. Requiring an already-recognized shared-gate change before classification allows that classification to be bypassed.
findings.smallest_fix: Restore product/spec normalization and standards-to-health-gate work as independent classification/reference-loading triggers, while retaining their separation from the technical-design trigger.

findings.failure_path: The required preservation check is incomplete: the packet removes lifecycle obligations but omits their resulting delivery-lifecycle sections, and omits the source-register row 598 exemption and relevant anchor-resolution implementation. The relocation inventory and GREEN table are claims, so they cannot establish that these obligations remain reachable or that the acknowledged missing anchor is safely handled.
findings.smallest_fix: Supply the relocated rule sections and affected anchor consumers, register row, and exemption binding as frozen review context for this candidate.
